missing_components.description: No workflows defined to automate processes or tasks.
No entities are defined; entity records may be needed for data representation.
No user interface modules are defined; potential UI elements are missing to interact with the system.
No catalog items are defined to link layout containers to functional elements.
No business logic rules are defined; logic for routing, validation, or computation may be absent.
No navigation menu is defined; hampers user journey and accessibility.
No integrations defined; the system could lack data synchronization with external systems.

risks.description: Lack of defined workflows may lead to manual process management, affecting efficiency.
Missing UI modules could lead to an inability for users to interact with core functionalities.
Absence of business logic rules may result in non-standardized processing and errors.

recommendations.action: Define workflows to automate essential processes.
Develop UI modules to provide user access to the application features.
Establish entities and relationships to create comprehensive data representation and management.
Introduce business logic rules to enforce process standardization and automation.
Set up a navigation menu to improve user experience and navigation efficiency.
